Frontend Developer

Globex makes scheduling software for clinics. Our product helps receptionists book thousands of appointments every day, and we want it to feel fast and calm.

The role

You will build features in React and TypeScript, work closely with our designer in Figma, and care about accessibility. You will pair with the backend team on our GraphQL API and help us keep the app quick on cheap phones.

About you

  • 3+ years of experience shipping React apps to production.
  • Strong CSS and HTML, and a habit of writing tests.
  • Clear written English; we work asynchronously across time zones.

This is a fully remote role and you can work from anywhere. We pay in USD and offer a learning budget, a laptop and flexible hours.
